017package org.apache.juneau.console.freemarker;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import java.io.*;
022import java.util.*;
023import java.util.logging.*;
024import java.util.regex.*;
025
026import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.*;
027import org.apache.juneau.console.*;
028import org.apache.juneau.console.views.*;
029import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.filter.*;

032import freemarker.core.*;
033import freemarker.template.*;

035/**
036 * The {@code <@console>} document-shell FreeMarker directive.
037 *
038 * <p>
039 * Renders its body into the per-render {@link PageCapture} (theme, navigation, header/footer slots, the banner region
040 * before {@code <@main/>}), then writes the document: the server-rendered {@code <head>}, the {@code <body>} tag, the
041 * {@code #juneau-page} contract island, one {@code <template>} per markup body, the {@code juneau-console.js} shell,
042 * and the server-emitted scripts. The shell renders the header, nav, cards and footer from the contract.
043 *
044 * <h2 class='section'>Example:</h2>
045 * <p class='bcode'>
046 *    &lt;@console brand="Release Manager" icon="/app/logo.svg" title="Releases"&gt;
047 *      &lt;@navigation&gt;
048 *        &lt;@node id="home" label="Home" href="/home"/&gt;
049 *      &lt;/@navigation&gt;
050 *      &lt;@main/&gt;
051 *      &lt;@footer text="ACME"/&gt;
052 *    &lt;/@console&gt;
053 * </p>
054 *
055 * @since 10.0.0
056 */
057@SuppressWarnings({
058   "java:S1192" // Duplicated literals read more clearly inline than as constants
059})
060public final class ConsoleDirectiveModel implements TemplateDirectiveModel {
061
062   /** The shared-variable name this directive registers under. */
063   public static final String NAME = "console";
064
065   private static final Logger LOG = Logger.getLogger(ConsoleDirectiveModel.class.getName());
066
067   static final Set<String> ATTRS = Set.of("theme", "icon", "favicon", "brand", "title", "chrome", "facts", "scheme", "schemeToggle");
068
069   private final boolean devMode;
070   private final CardTypeRegistry cardTypes;
071   private final ToolkitPackRegistry packs;
072
073   ConsoleDirectiveModel(boolean devMode, CardTypeRegistry cardTypes, ToolkitPackRegistry packs) {
074      this.devMode = devMode;
075      this.cardTypes = cardTypes;
076      this.packs = packs;
077   }
078
079   @Override
080   @SuppressWarnings({
081      "java:S3776", // Attribute validation and document emission read best as one straight-line method.
082      "resource", // FreeMarker owns env.getOut(); closing it would close the HTTP response.
083      "unchecked" // FreeMarker's raw params Map is String-keyed by contract.
084   })
085   public void execute(Environment env, @SuppressWarnings("rawtypes") Map params, TemplateModel[] loopVars,
086         TemplateDirectiveBody body) throws TemplateException, IOException {
087      Map<String, TemplateModel> p = params;
088      if (p.containsKey("format"))
089         throw FtlAttrLists.reject("<@console> has no format= attribute.");
090      FtlAttrLists.rejectUnknown(p, NAME, ATTRS);
091
092      var req = FreemarkerRenderScope.request();
093      if (n(req))
094         throw FtlAttrLists.reject("<@console> needs FreemarkerRenderScope.request() (renderer wrap).");
095
096      var cap = PageCapture.of(env);
097      if (cap.consoleOpen || cap.consoleDone)
098         throw FtlAttrLists.reject("<@console> cannot be nested inside another <@console>.");
099
100      // Fail-closed validate an explicit theme= attribute up front; a nested <@theme> (or, absent both, a theme seeded
101      // by a page spec) decides the final name below.
102      var themeAttr = FtlAttrLists.scalar(p, "theme");
103      if (! themeAttr.isEmpty() && ! ConsoleChromeMixin.BUILTIN_THEME_NAMES.contains(themeAttr))
104         throw FtlAttrLists.reject("<@console> unknown theme name '" + themeAttr + "'.  Built-in themes: "
105            + String.join(", ", ConsoleChromeMixin.BUILTIN_THEME_NAMES) + ".");
106
107      // Colour scheme: an explicit attribute wins over a page-spec value, which wins over the default.
108      var schemeAttr = FtlAttrLists.scalar(p, "scheme");
109      if (! schemeAttr.isEmpty() && ! ConsoleChromeMixin.SCHEMES.contains(schemeAttr))
110         throw FtlAttrLists.reject("<@console> unknown scheme '" + schemeAttr + "'.  Schemes: "
111            + String.join(", ", ConsoleChromeMixin.SCHEMES) + ".");
112      var capScheme = nn(cap.scheme()) ? cap.scheme() : ConsoleChromeMixin.SCHEMES.get(0);
113      var scheme = schemeAttr.isEmpty() ? capScheme : schemeAttr;
114      var schemeToggle = FtlAttrLists.strictBoolean(p, NAME, "schemeToggle", cap.schemeToggle());
115
116      var icon = FtlAttrLists.scalar(p, "icon");
117      var favicon = FtlAttrLists.scalar(p, "favicon");
118      var iconSymbol = symbolName("icon", icon);
119      var faviconSymbol = symbolName("favicon", favicon);
120      if (nn(faviconSymbol))
121         favicon = req.getUriResolver().resolve("servlet:" + ViewsMixin.SYMBOL_SVG_PATH.replace("{file}", faviconSymbol + ".svg"));
122      var faviconHref = favicon;
123      var brand = FtlAttrLists.scalar(p, "brand");
124      var titleAttr = FtlAttrLists.scalar(p, "title");
125      var chrome = FtlAttrLists.strictBoolean(p, NAME, "chrome", false);
126      var factsAttr = FtlAttrLists.map(p, NAME, "facts");
127
128      // Document <title>: a title seeded by a page spec wins; else the title= attribute, else brand=; omitted when none.
129      var docTitle = titleAttr.isEmpty() ? brand : titleAttr;
130      cap.titleDefault(docTitle);
131      cap.header(h -> {
132         if (! brand.isEmpty())
133            h.title(brand);
134         if (nn(iconSymbol))
135            h.logoSymbol(iconSymbol, req.getUriResolver().resolve("context:/"), brand.isEmpty() ? null : brand);
136         else if (! icon.isEmpty())
137            h.logo(icon, req.getUriResolver().resolve("context:/"), brand.isEmpty() ? null : brand);
138         h.chrome(chrome);
139      });
140
141      // Chrome-side facts: last-wins against <@facts>; the one strict check against PageSpec.facts runs at </@console>.
142      if (! factsAttr.isEmpty())
143         cap.mergeChromeFacts(factsAttr);
144
145      cap.consoleTheme = themeAttr.isEmpty() ? null : themeAttr;
146      cap.consoleOpen = true;
147      try {
148         if (nn(body))
149            body.render(cap.consoleBuffer());
150      } finally {
151         cap.consoleOpen = false;
152      }
153      cap.checkConsoleClose();
154      try {
155         cap.checkWiring(cardTypes);
156      } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
157         throw FtlAttrLists.reject(e.getMessage());
158      }
159      cap.resolveActiveNav();
160
161      // A page that never reached <@page> (a PageSpec rendered straight through the chrome) has not had its seeded
162      // toolkits and card-required packs resolved yet; <@page> does it itself, so never twice.
163      // The guard is a pure optimisation: toolkitAssets overwrites, and nothing after <@page> can change its inputs
164      // (<@card> is only legal inside <@page>), so a second resolve would be identical and no test can observe it.
165      if (! cap.assetsResolved())
166         PageDirectiveModel.resolveAssets(env, cap, packs);
167
168      if (n(cap.themeCssUrl)) {
169         // No <@theme> ran: an explicit theme= wins, else a theme seeded by a page spec is inherited, else the default.
170         var themeName = themeAttr.isEmpty() ? cap.themeOrNull() : themeAttr;
171         if (themeName == null)
172            themeName = ConsoleChromeMixin.BUILTIN_THEME_NAMES.get(0);
173         cap.themeCssUrl = ConsoleChromeMixin.themeAssetUrl(req, themeName);
174         cap.theme(themeName);
175      }
176
177      // Each embed asks for its own value, so a masking boundary never repeats the same masked token in one page.
178      var metaToken = csrfToken(req);
179      var bodyToken = csrfToken(req);
180      var csrfHeader = req.getAttribute(RequestBoundaryFilter.HEADER_ATTRIBUTE).asString().orElse(null);
181      var hasCsrf = inb(metaToken) && inb(bodyToken);
182
183      // A page that carries a token must not be cached, and the header has to be set before any of the body is
184      // written.  A response that is already committed can no longer be marked, so it never carries the token: both
185      // automatic embeds and any spec- or <@body>-authored csrf attributes are dropped, and the page's own writes then
186      // fail visibly instead of leaking the secret.
187      var bodyAttrs = cap.bodyAttrs;
188      if (req.getResponse().getHttpServletResponse().isCommitted()) {
189         var omitted = hasCsrf;
190         hasCsrf = false;
191         bodyAttrs = cap.bodyAttrsWithout("data-juneau-csrf", "data-juneau-csrf-header");
192         if (bodyAttrs != null && ! bodyAttrs.equals(cap.bodyAttrs.strip()))
193            omitted = true;
194         if (omitted)
195            LOG.fine("Response already committed; the CSRF token is not embedded in the page.");
196      } else if (hasCsrf || cap.hasBodyAttr("data-juneau-csrf")) {
197         RequestBoundaryFilter.markTokenBearing(req.getResponse().getHttpServletResponse());
198      }
199
200      if (devMode) {
201         var findings = PageContractSchema.get().validate(cap.toContractJson(), cap.templates().keySet());
202         if (! findings.isEmpty())
203            throw FtlAttrLists.reject(f("Page contract failed schema validation: '%s'.", String.join("; ", findings)));
204      }
205
206      if (cap.allowInlineHandlers())
207         checkInlineCsp(req);
208
209      var out = env.getOut();
210      var nonce = req.getAttribute(RestRequest.CSP_NONCE_ATTR).as(String.class).orElse(null);
211      var htmlAttrs = ConsoleChromeMixin.schemeHtmlAttributes(scheme, schemeToggle);
212      out.write("<!DOCTYPE html>\n<html lang=\"en\"" + (htmlAttrs.isEmpty() ? "" : " " + htmlAttrs) + ">\n<head>\n");
213      // The pre-paint scheme script runs before any stylesheet so the first paint already has the right scheme.
214      out.write(ConsoleChromeMixin.schemeScriptElement(nonce) + "\n");
215      out.write("<meta charset=\"utf-8\">\n");
216      out.write("<meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\">\n");
217      if (! cap.title().isEmpty())
218         out.write("<title>" + attrEscape(cap.title()) + "</title>\n");
219      if (! cap.tab().isEmpty())
220         out.write("<meta name=\"page-tab\" content=\"" + attrEscape(cap.tab()) + "\">\n");
221      if (hasCsrf)
222         out.write("<meta name=\"csrf-token\" content=\"" + attrEscape(metaToken) + "\">\n");
223      if (! faviconHref.isEmpty())
224         out.write("<link rel=\"icon\" href=\"" + attrEscape(faviconHref) + "\">\n");
225      out.write("<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"" + attrEscape(ConsoleChromeMixin.chromeCssUrl(req)) + "\">\n");
226      out.write("<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"" + attrEscape(ConsoleChromeMixin.themeAssetUrl(req, "dark")) + "\">\n");
227      out.write("<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"" + attrEscape(cap.themeCssUrl) + "\">\n");
228      if (nn(cap.themeOverrideBlock))
229         out.write("<style" + ConsoleChromeMixin.nonceAttr(nonce) + ">" + cap.themeOverrideBlock + "</style>\n");
230      // App CSS that must lose to page-local css=: emitted BEFORE the page css so a page rule still wins.
231      if (nn(cap.headBeforePageCss))
232         out.write(cap.headBeforePageCss);
233      for (var href : cap.vendorCss())
234         out.write("<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"" + attrEscape(href) + "\" data-toolkit-css>\n");
235      for (var href : cap.cssHrefs())
236         out.write("<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"" + attrEscape(href) + "\">\n");
237      for (var href : cap.runtimeCss())
238         out.write("<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"" + attrEscape(href) + "\" data-toolkit-css>\n");
239      if (nn(cap.head))
240         out.write(cap.head);
241      out.write("\n</head>\n");
242
243      out.write("<body");
244      // A spec- or <@body>-authored csrf attribute (merged by checkConsoleClose above) wins over the auto-detection.
245      // Either name suppresses both auto attributes, so a token and its header never come from different sources.
246      if (hasCsrf && ! cap.hasBodyAttr("data-juneau-csrf") && ! cap.hasBodyAttr("data-juneau-csrf-header")) {
247         out.write(" data-juneau-csrf=\"" + attrEscape(bodyToken) + "\"");
248         if (inb(csrfHeader))
249            out.write(" data-juneau-csrf-header=\"" + attrEscape(csrfHeader) + "\"");
250      }
251      if (inb(bodyAttrs))
252         out.write(" " + bodyAttrs.trim());
253      out.write(">\n");
254
255      cap.shellUrl(ConsoleChromeMixin.consoleJsUrl(req));
256      cap.writeBody(out);
257      out.write("\n");
258
259      for (var src : cap.vendorJs())
260         out.write("<script src=\"" + attrEscape(src) + "\" data-toolkit-js></script>\n");
261      for (var src : cap.runtimeJs())
262         out.write("<script src=\"" + attrEscape(src) + "\" data-toolkit-js></script>\n");
263      // The inline-handler compiler is the one script that compiles strings; it is not in any pack and is emitted
264      // only for a page that opted in, after the runtime pack (which holds the model it plugs into).
265      if (cap.allowInlineHandlers())
266         out.write("<script" + ConsoleChromeMixin.nonceAttr(nonce) + " src=\"" + attrEscape(ViewsMixin.viewAssetUrl(req, ViewsMixin.MODEL_INLINE_JS_PATH)) + "\" data-toolkit-js></script>\n");
267      // The badge runtime mounts header.badges from the contract on load.  Not a toolkit pack: a chrome-template
268      // <@badge> is only known here, after the page's packs were resolved.
269      if (cap.hasBadges())
270         out.write("<script src=\"" + attrEscape(ConsoleChromeMixin.badgesJsUrl(req)) + "\" data-toolkit-js></script>\n");
271      // App scripts that must run after the toolkit pack but before the page-local init= scripts.
272      if (nn(cap.scriptsAfterToolkit))
273         out.write(cap.scriptsAfterToolkit);
274      for (var src : cap.initScripts())
275         out.write("<script src=\"" + attrEscape(src) + "\"></script>\n");
276      if (nn(cap.scripts))
277         out.write(cap.scripts);
278      out.write("\n</body>\n</html>\n");
279      cap.consoleDone = true;
280   }
281
282   /**
283    * One CSRF token value for one embed, or <jk>null</jk> when the request carries none.
284    *
285    * <p>
286    * Prefers the filter's token supplier, read straight from the servlet request: converting it through the REST
287    * attribute view would stringify the supplier itself.  Only the filter's own {@link RequestBoundaryFilter.TokenSupplier}
288    * is trusted; a value of any other type under that name was set by request code, so no token is embedded.  Falls
289    * back to the single string value for a filter that publishes only that.
290    */
291   private static final Pattern SYMBOL_NAME = Pattern.compile("[a-z0-9_]{1,64}");
292
293   // Returns the symbol name when value is "symbol:<name>", null when it is not a symbol reference; rejects a bad name.
294   private static String symbolName(String attr, String value) throws TemplateModelException {
295      if (! value.startsWith("symbol:"))
296         return null;
297      var name = value.substring("symbol:".length());
298      if (! SYMBOL_NAME.matcher(name).matches())
299         throw FtlAttrLists.reject(f("<@console> %s='%s' needs a symbol name matching [a-z0-9_]{1,64}.", attr, value));
300      return name;
301   }
302
303   private static String csrfToken(RestRequest req) {
304      var supplier = req.getHttpServletRequest().getAttribute(RequestBoundaryFilter.TOKEN_SUPPLIER_ATTRIBUTE);
305      if (supplier instanceof RequestBoundaryFilter.TokenSupplier s)
306         return s.get();
307      if (supplier != null)
308         return null;
309      return req.getAttribute(RequestBoundaryFilter.TOKEN_ATTRIBUTE).asString().orElse(null);
310   }
311
312   /** Minimal HTML-attribute escape for an author-/request-supplied value placed in a double-quoted attribute. */
313   private static String attrEscape(String s) {
314      return s.replace("&", "&amp;").replace("<", "&lt;").replace(">", "&gt;").replace("\"", "&quot;");
315   }
316
317   /**
318    * Fails fast when a page opts in to inline handlers under a CSP that would block them.  Every
319    * {@code Content-Security-Policy} value already on the response is checked: its effective script directive
320    * ({@code script-src}, else {@code default-src}) must list {@code 'unsafe-eval'}.  A header added after this point
321    * is not seen here; the client reports it as a loud failure instead.
322    */
323   private static void checkInlineCsp(RestRequest req) {
324      var values = req.getResponse().getHttpServletResponse().getHeaders("Content-Security-Policy");
325      if (values == null || values.isEmpty())
326         return;
327      for (var v : values)
328         if (! allowsEval(v))
329            throw new IllegalStateException("allowInlineHandlers(true) needs 'unsafe-eval' in script-src; the response CSP is: " + String.join(", ", values));
330   }
331
332   private static boolean allowsEval(String policy) {
333      String script = null;
334      String dflt = null;
335      for (var d : policy.split(";")) {
336         var t = d.trim();
337         var lower = t.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
338         if (lower.equals("script-src") || lower.startsWith("script-src "))
339            script = t;
340         else if (lower.equals("default-src") || lower.startsWith("default-src "))
341            dflt = t;
342      }
343      var effective = script != null ? script : dflt;
344      return effective == null || effective.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT).contains(org.apache.juneau.http.header.ContentSecurityPolicy.Builder.UNSAFE_EVAL);
345   }
346}
